title: Akihabara for Cecilia: 3 ways to spend the evening
h1: Three ways to spend the evening.
lead: Three plans for a private tour, all 16:00 to 19:00. We start in daylight and end under the neon.
subject: Cecilia — Akihabara plan
meet_sub: The same start for every course
meet_text: Akihabara Station, Electric Town exit, at 16:00.
meet_hint: Come out of the Electric Town exit and Radio Kaikan is the tall building straight ahead.
footer: Reply to Yuuki with the letter of the course you want. Times are approximate and can move on the day.
